ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Beam Damage Minimization
ada:methodParameters.schema:description: Description of the approach used to minimize beam damage, especially Na- and K-loss in glasses, micas, and hydrous minerals.
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Durango apatite tested for halogen volatilization under beam; no significant volatile loss observed between 3 µm and 10 µm spot conditions

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
ada:methodParameters.schema:description: Whether a halogen correction was applied to calculate oxygen content by stoichiometry in halogen-bearing phases.
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Yes (F measured; Cl measured; OH by difference)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent identified by the analyte row.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: EPMA Technique per Element
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Whether this element was measured by WDS or EDS.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: WDS Spectrometer Channel
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: WDS spectrometer number used for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Sequence
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Order of analysis on spectormeter.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Diffracting Crystal
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analysing crystal (monochromator) used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Proportional Counter / Detector
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Type of detector used in the WDS spectrometer for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: WDS PHA Setting
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Pulse height analyzer setting used for the WDS detector.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: X-ray Line
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: The X-ray emission line measured for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Default Peak Counting Time
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position in seconds.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Default Background Counting Time
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Total time spent counting at background position(s) in seconds.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Typical Background Position(s)
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Positions of background measurements relative to the peak, in mm and/or sinθ, and whether on the high or low energy side.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Blank Correction
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Method and reference materials used to determine and apply blank corrections.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: EDS Dead Time
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Percent dead time reported by the EDS spectrometer

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Background Correction Method
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Method used to estimate and subtract background X-ray intensity beneath the peak.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Type of time-dependent intensity correction applied for volatile or beam-sensitive elements.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Element Estimation Method
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: How elemental concentrations were calculated — directly from measured X-ray intensities or via cation stoichiometry.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Primary reference material used for element standardization (calibration).

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: List of quality-control reference materials (secondary standards) routinely analyzed alongside unknowns.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Interference Corrections Applied
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Flag indicating whether a spectral interference correction was applied for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Interfering Elements
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: List of elements whose X-ray lines overlap with the measured line for this element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Interference Correction Standard
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Reference material used to quantify and calibrate the interference correction.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Typical Detection Limit
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3σ) for each measured element.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Detection Limit Method
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Method used to compute detection limits.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Typical Analytical Precision
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent standard, expressed as 1σ relative standard deviation (%).

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Typical Analytical Accuracy
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as % relative bias.

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Typical Counting Statistics Error
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: 1σ uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities.
